# Sounio

> A self-hosted systems and scientific programming language for epistemic computing, uncertainty propagation, and algebraic effects.

Sounio is a research programming language with native support for uncertainty quantification (Knowledge<T> with GUM propagation), physical units, algebraic effects (IO, Mut, Div, Panic, Alloc, Async, GPU, Prob, Observe), and refinement types. The compiler is written in Sounio and compiles to Linux x86-64; a native macOS ARM64 route with Metal execution exists. The standard library spans pharmacology (PBPK models), ontology (EL+ reasoner verified in Lean 4), particle physics, quantum computing, chemistry, and numerical computing.

## Learn

https://www.souniolang.org/learn/

Language guide, epistemic types, effects, standard library reference, and runnable examples.

## Honest Status

https://www.souniolang.org/honesty/

Honest implementation status, known limitations, and what does and does not work in the current compiler artifact.
